title: Disney Magic Kingdom Happily Ever After Fireworks
venue: Magic Kingdom Park, Walt Disney World Resort
address: 1180 Seven Seas Dr, Lake Buena Vista, FL 32830
summary: Happily Ever After pairs aerial fireworks with castle projections at Magic Kingdom. Park admission is required for the in-park experience. Check Disney's dated entertainment calendar for the November 28 showtime.
viewingTips: Try the Ticket & Transportation Center (TTC) ferry landing, the Polynesian Village Resort beach, or the Grand Floridian marina waterfront if open to visitors. Synchronized audio may be available at select spots. Confirm access and audio with Disney before setting out.
parkingTips: Use the designated Magic Kingdom lot for TTC access and check parking fees. Resort parking is subject to resort policies.
transitTips: Use the resort monorail or available boat service and check return service after the show.
safetyNotes: Stay behind waterfront barriers and keep ferry queues and walkways open.

title: Disneyland Park Anaheim Nighttime Fireworks Spectacular
summary: Disneyland's seasonal nighttime spectacular combines fireworks with lighting and music. Valid park admission and a same-day park reservation are required for the in-park show.
viewingTips: Try the outer Downtown Disney walkways, designated open areas of the Esplanade, or public Harbor Boulevard sidewalks with an unobstructed view. Follow security directions.
parkingTips: Use designated Disney or public parking and check current fees and closing times.
transitTips: Plan your return bus or rideshare pickup away from park exit crowds.
safetyNotes: Keep sidewalks, security lanes, and crossings clear. Wind can cancel aerial fireworks.

title: SeaWorld San Diego Mission Bay Fireworks Spectacular
address: 500 Sea World Dr, San Diego, CA 92109
summary: SeaWorld stages select-night fireworks over Mission Bay. The November 28 time in this listing is unconfirmed, and SeaWorld lists December 12 and 31 for its Christmas fireworks.
viewingTips: Look for open waterfront at South Shores Park or along the grassy Fiesta Island shoreline. Check access hours and posted closures before choosing a spot.
parkingTips: Park in a designated bay lot and check gate closing times before the show.
transitTips: Check evening transit service and plan the walk from your stop in advance.
safetyNotes: Use lit paths where available and stay back from the water and restricted areas.

title: Waikiki Beach Friday Night Fireworks at Hilton Hawaiian Village
summary: Hilton Hawaiian Village's weekly Friday fireworks are free to watch from the Waikiki shoreline. Hilton lists a 7:45 PM start from October through May.
viewingTips: Arrive early at Duke Kahanamoku Beach for a clear view or use the Waikiki-facing side of Magic Island if open.
parkingTips: Check posted hours for Ala Moana Beach Park lots or use a designated Waikiki garage.
transitTips: Use TheBus or walk from nearby Waikiki lodging. Check evening return times.
safetyNotes: Stay outside marked launch areas, keep shoreline paths clear, and avoid entering the water after dark.
